calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Oct-18-2011 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of an Aduld and Two Minors.
Dept. 218, Judge: Tomar Mason, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Brenda Fields, #7235.

Petitioner Yingyan Chen was present in pro per on behalf of herself, and as Guardian ad Litem for the minors Mengyi Chen and Mengting Cao, who were not present at today's hearing.
Jenny Yau was placed under oath and served as Cantonese speaking interpreter for petitioner.
Petitioner was placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Publication in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to Wendy Yingyan Chen.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Minors to Annie Mengyi Cao & Kate Mengting Cao.

Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
